target: Full Manim Community 0.20.1 capability parity with a Rust-owned renderer

policy.supported: Every corpus assertion for the tier has passed against the Rust renderer.
policy.partial: Some underlying primitives exist, but one or more Manim semantics or visual assertions are not implemented.
policy.missing: The Rust runtime has no conforming implementation yet.
policy.noFallback: A compatibility result may not be counted as supported when regular Manim rendered the output.
